risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, with clear explanations of revenue declines, inventory growth, cash flows, dividends, and credit-facility terms. Risk tone is cautiously positive, but management relies on forward-looking assurances regarding backlog, inventory normalization, liquidity sufficiency, and immaterial effects of new accounting standards. Related-party transactions and significant estimation judgments are disclosed, though some explanations attribute changes to broad business fluctuations.
